title: Deep-research groundings for the microbedecoder residual chemicals
body:
## What

Literature/database deep-research over the microbedecoder residual **chemicals** the existing grounding passes deferred to deep research (targeting the genuine residual, not labels already grounded on #192). 10 parallel literature-search subagents; the 20 single-compound CHEBI decisions were each adversarially re-verified (all CONFIRMED).

## Applied in this PR (3 net-new groundings)

Promoted `unmapped/` → `mapped/` via `scripts/promote_resolved_unmapped.py` (canary-first). Gates green: `reconcile_sssom` GAP 0 / ORPHAN 0 / STALE 0, id-label ✅, SSSOM Rules A/B1/B2/B3, `validate-strict` 0 errors / 2898 files.

| residual label | → CHEBI |
|---|---|
| Diacetyl | CHEBI:16583 butane-2,3-dione |
| Ferric Iron | CHEBI:29034 iron(3+) |
| Sodium(+) | CHEBI:29101 sodium(1+) |

## Not applied — reclassified during apply

Working the other 17 against MIM's existing records changed the picture:

- **7 already mapped** under a canonical label (α-/β-hydroxybutyrate = 2-/3-hydroxybutyrate, Achromycin = Tetracycline, neomycin E = Paromomycin, (+)-D-glycogen = Glycogen, (+)-L-lyxitol = Arabitol, RNA already on CHEBI:33697). Recorded as **synonym-merge** recommendations, NOT force-promoted — the RNA case needs a curator split (generic RNA vs the Torula-yeast product record). Follow-up: #208.
- **6 antibiotics** absent from local `chebi.db` (>747618; OLS4-validated) — unblock on the #200 refresh.
- **filipin** (broadMatch → registry sibling needed) + **3 non-CHEBI parse/variant** items (merge into existing `MIM:Peptone` / `MIM:Yeast_Extract`).

Per-row disposition tracked in `mappings/microbedecoder_residual_research_proposed.sssom.tsv` (`validation_method`: APPLIED / ALREADY_MAPPED / DEFERRED_*).

## Deliverables

- `notes/microbedecoder_residual_research_2026-08-04.md` — full report + disposition.
- `mappings/microbedecoder_residual_research_proposed.sssom.tsv` — single-term ledger.
- `mappings/microbedecoder_residual_research_proposed.tsv` / `_decomposition.tsv` — research tables (43 multi-component labels not applied).

Related: #200 (chebi.db refresh), #204 (verify MICRO:0000520), #208 (synonym-merge follow-up).
